note: Editable mapping of opponents to archetypes. Taxonomy follows the NHRL wiki weapon-type categories. Strengths/weaknesses are general knowledge summarised from RobotCombatWiki and Combat Robots Wiki, not about specific robots. Confidence: high = stated on the robot’s NHRL wiki page; none = could not verify (archetype “unknown”).

supernova.evidence: NHRL wiki Robot Facts: Weapon “Vertical Spinner/ Eggbeater”.

archetypes.name: Vertical spinner
archetypes.definition: Weapon spins on a horizontal axis so the teeth come up from underneath and strike upward (bar, disc or eggbeater).
strengths: Big upward hits that throw opponents
Recoil goes into the floor, so it stays planted
Often self-rights with the weapon (gyro)
weaknesses: Gyro effect makes fast turns hard
Only dangerous from the front: flankers can push it
Weapon-to-weapon hits with other verts/drums are hard on both
archetypes.matchupNote: Vert vs vert/drum: close and violent; faster tip speed tends to win weapon-to-weapon hits.

archetypes.name: Drum
archetypes.definition: Short, wide spinning cylinder mounted low across the front, spinning upward.
strengths: Easy to aim: covers the whole front
Compact and tough, weapon supported on both sides
Recoil goes into the floor
weaknesses: Smaller diameter means less energy and bite than a big vert
Sensitive to arena seams and debris
Only dangerous from the front
archetypes.matchupNote: Drum vs vert: weapon-to-weapon hits are common and hard on belts, bearings and teeth.

archetypes.name: Eggbeater
archetypes.definition: Vertical spinner whose weapon is an open loop (square or rounded frame) between two supports: between a drum and a bar.
strengths: Stores more energy than a disc of the same mass and diameter
Wide hitting area; forgiving to aim
weaknesses: High air drag can overload the weapon motor or ESC
Shares vert weaknesses (gyro, front-only)

archetypes.name: Horizontal spinner
archetypes.definition: Weapon spins flat, parallel to the floor, on a vertical axis (bar or disc; mid-height “midcutter” or overhead).
strengths: Wide attack zone, easier to aim than a vert
No gyro wheel-lift when turning
Long reach; good against exposed wheels and parts
weaknesses: Recoil throws it sideways, into walls or hazards
Tipping (e.g. on a wedge) can cause a gyro tumble
Low wedges and verts can get under the weapon
archetypes.matchupNote: For a vertical spinner this matchup is “often favorable”: the vert can hit the blade from underneath and throw the whole robot.

archetypes.name: Undercutter
archetypes.definition: Horizontal spinner mounted very low, just above the floor, hitting wheels, forks, wedge edges and the underside.
strengths: Pokes under opponents; hard for wedges or verts to reach
Tears off wheels and breaks forks
Described as generally the most competitive horizontal
weaknesses: Recoil and wall bounce like other horizontals
Can be deflected by hard wedges

archetypes.name: Full-body spinner (shell / ring)
archetypes.definition: The robot’s shell or a ring around it spins as the weapon.
strengths: 360° attack area
Very heavy weapon; shell also works as armour
weaknesses: Long spin-up; hard to build, often unreliable
Shell spinners can’t drive inverted

archetypes.name: Meltybrain
archetypes.definition: Whole robot spins and can still translate by pulsing its drive once per rotation.
strengths: 360° attack while still able to move
weaknesses: Chaotic; complex control electronics/code

archetypes.name: Flipper
archetypes.definition: Fast actuator that launches the opponent up and over.
strengths: Wins by control and displacement with little self-damage
Can double as a self-righting mechanism
weaknesses: Lives or dies on ground game: needs to get under first
Needs a burst of energy; reset time on spring designs
archetypes.matchupNote: For a vertical spinner this is “a dangerous matchup”: if the flipper gets underneath, a vert that can’t self-right can lose quickly.

archetypes.name: Lifter
archetypes.definition: Slow, powerful arm that raises the opponent to unbalance, carry or pin it.
strengths: High control, low self-damage
Can flip opponents that can’t self-right
weaknesses: Slow; limited flip height
Depends on getting under the opponent

archetypes.name: Grappler
archetypes.definition: Lifter with a second arm that clamps the opponent and lifts it clear of the floor (grappler / suplexer).
strengths: Can carry or pin opponents
weaknesses: Must get hold of the opponent first

archetypes.name: Hammer / axe
archetypes.definition: Swings an arm down onto the opponent.
strengths: Hits the top armour, which few robots protect
weaknesses: Tends to be slower, with exposed arms
archetypes.matchupNote: For a vertical spinner this is “usually favorable”, but a hammer that lands on the weapon or electronics can do real damage.

archetypes.name: Hammersaw
archetypes.definition: Overhead arm carrying a small spinner, saw or drill, swung down onto the opponent’s top armour.
strengths: High odds of hitting internals through thin top armour
weaknesses: Mechanically complex

archetypes.name: Rammer / wedge / control
archetypes.definition: No real active weapon: wins by getting under, pushing and controlling the opponent (wedges, forks, plows).
strengths: Being underneath breaks the opponent’s traction and disables many weapons
Durable; aims for judges’ decisions
weaknesses: Needs high acceleration, traction and a skilled driver
Plain wedges struggle to get under modern forks
archetypes.matchupNote: For a vertical spinner it “depends on who gets underneath”.

archetypes.name: Crusher
archetypes.definition: Squeezes or pierces the opponent with a powerful jaw or arm. (Not a separate NHRL wiki weapon category.)
strengths: Control plus piercing damage
weaknesses: Must grab the opponent first

archetypes.name: Multibot
archetypes.definition: Two or more separate robots that together make the weight limit.
strengths: Two threats at once; harder to fully knock out
weaknesses: Each robot is lighter, with less armour and weapon each

archetypes.name: Unique weapon
archetypes.definition: Weapon that doesn’t fit the standard types.

archetypes.name: Unknown / unverified
archetypes.definition: No public source found for this robot’s weapon type yet. Set it yourself if you know it.
